title: Consistent Bars
description: A pack to change all of the bars in Minecraft to mimic that of the experience bar
body:
Ever looked at your experience bar and thought, “I need more of that?”
This texture pack is built exactly for that feeling.

It emphasizes your XP bar by making all other bars above the hotbar look jsut like it!

Installation
- Download the pack
- Move it into your resourcepacks folder
- Enable it in-game
